MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WITH DISTINCT p, DATE_DIFF('year', CAST(REPLACE(p.birth_date, '/', '-') AS DATE), CAST('2026-10-14' AS DATE)) AS age
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:PlaysFor]->(t:Team)
WITH DISTINCT p, age, t
WHERE (age < 42 AND CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) <= 1)
   OR (t.team_name = 'Detroit Pistons' AND p.college = 'Temple University')
RETURN p.college AS col1, age AS col2, p.position AS col3, p.name AS name_player

MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WITH DISTINCT p, CAST(REPLACE(p.birth_date, '/', '-') AS DATE) AS birth_date
WITH p,
     date_part('year', CAST('2026-10-14' AS DATE)) - date_part('year', birth_date) -
     CASE
       WHEN date_part('month', birth_date) > date_part('month', CAST('2026-10-14' AS DATE))
         OR (date_part('month', birth_date) = date_part('month', CAST('2026-10-14' AS DATE))
             AND date_part('day', birth_date) > date_part('day', CAST('2026-10-14' AS DATE)))
       THEN 1 ELSE 0
     END AS age

   OR (t.team_name = 'Detroit Pistons' AND p.college = 'Temple University')

MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WITH DISTINCT p,
  CASE
    WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS '/' THEN STRPTIME(p.birth_date, '%Y/%m/%d')
    ELSE STRPTIME(p.birth_date, '%B %d, %Y')
  END AS birth_date
WITH p,
  date_part('year', CAST('2026-10-14' AS DATE)) - date_part('year', birth_date) -
  CASE
    WHEN date_part('month', birth_date) > date_part('month', CAST('2026-10-14' AS DATE))
      OR (date_part('month', birth_date) = date_part('month', CAST('2026-10-14' AS DATE))
          AND date_part('day', birth_date) > date_part('day', CAST('2026-10-14' AS DATE)))
    THEN 1 ELSE 0
  END AS age
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:PlaysFor]->(t:Team)
WHERE (age < 42 AND CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) <= 1)
   OR (t.team_name = 'Detroit Pistons' AND p.college = 'Temple University')
RETURN DISTINCT p.college AS col1, age AS col2, p.position AS col3, p.name AS name_player
